title: EmbodiedRSI: Active Continual Robot Learning Through Hypothesis-Guided Co-Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.10498v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Robot foundation models provide strong visuomotor control, yet their performance can degrade when object positions or task instructions change. Further improvements often require post-training on substantial robot data, which can be costly to collect through methods such as teleoperation. Agentic harnesses can adapt around the model, but current self-evolving harnesses use robot trials inefficiently when deciding which code and skill changes to pursue. We introduce EmbodiedRSI, a self-evolving agentic harness that autonomously decides where to explore next and turns the resulting physical interaction into improved code and skills. EmbodiedRSI realizes this through a Fast-Slow Dual-System Architecture, in which competing code and skill hypotheses are maintained in a Hypothesis Graph. Value-of-Information Experiment Selection chooses physical experiments that can distinguish these hypotheses. Their outcomes guide Code-Skill Co-Evolutio

translated_title: EmbodiedRSI：通过假设引导的协同进化实现主动持续机器人学习
translated_abstract: 机器人基础模型提供了强大的视觉运动控制能力，但当物体位置或任务指令发生变化时，其性能可能会下降。进一步的改进通常需要在大量机器人数据上进行后训练，而通过遥操作等方式收集这些数据的成本高昂。智能体框架可以在模型外围进行适配调整，但目前的自进化框架在决定 pursuing 哪些代码和技能变更时，对机器人试验资源的利用效率低下。我们提出了EmbodiedRSI，这是一个自进化的智能体框架，能够自主决定下一步在哪里进行探索，并将由此产生的物理交互转化为改进后的代码和技能。EmbodiedRSI通过“快-慢双系统架构”来实现这一目标，在该架构中，相互竞争的代码和技能假设被维护在一个“假设图”中。“信息价值实验选择”机制会选择能够区分这些假设的物理实验，实验结果则进一步指导“代码-技能协同进化”。
tldr: 该论文提出EmbodiedRSI，一个自进化智能体框架，通过快-慢双系统架构、假设图与信息价值实验选择机制，自主决策探索方向并将物理交互转化为代码与技能的协同进化，从而高效提升机器人应对环境变化的能力。
en_tdlr: EmbodiedRSI is a self-evolving agentic harness that autonomously decides where to explore and converts physical interactions into improved code and skills through a Fast-Slow Dual-System Architecture, a Hypothesis Graph, and Value-of-Information Experiment Selection enabling Code-Skill Co-Evolution.
